content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

How many property sales were recorded in the town of LEEDS in the year 2023?

content.statement:
SELECT *
FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(
    ANALYTICS.UK.UK_PRICE_PAID_SEMANTIC
    METRICS sales_count
    WHERE uk_price_paid.town = 'LEEDS'
    AND uk_price_paid.date >= '2023-01-01'
    AND uk_price_paid.date < '2024-01-01'
)
